title: Libre 2 uk
symptom: User asks about using Libre 2 in the UK without a MiaoMiao 2, wondering if it's possible and if readings can still be sent to clinic.
evidence_quote: Hiya so I'm one of probably many people getting the libre 2 upgrade soon. I heard it is possible to not have to use miaomiao 2 with the new libre but it seems to be the usa version only? Also I would still need to be able to send the readings for the clinic to review.
